subject: Small invoice mismatch
text: Sorry, this is scattered. I started writing earlier and got pulled into another task, so I might repeat myself. The issue is the invoice description for Tuesday's revision round. I thought we agreed it counted as one bundled change request, but your comment in the shared folder sounded like three separate items billed hourly. That is not a big fight, just a mismatch. I do not want to overcharge or make reporting difficult. If you prefer, I can split it the way your budget notes need, or leave it combined and attach the brief. Let me know and I will revise before end of day.
